purpose: Separate default-suite setup collision from actual Litmus/WebDAV behavior

conditions.target: real WebDAV adapter on a fresh isolated Local repository
conditions.parent_created_by: Python stdlib HTTP MKCOL before Litmus

interpretation: The copymove begin sequence passed on a fresh path, so the original subsequent-group MKCOL 405 was not a standalone inability to create a collection. The baseline debug log shows each later group first DELETE /litmus/ -> 409 (non-empty collection), then MKCOL /litmus/ -> 405 (resource still mapped). RFC 4918 permits/defines 405 for MKCOL on a mapped URL and requires collection DELETE to operate recursively. Thus the 405 is secondary to cleanup failure; the failed recursive DELETE is a WebDAV compatibility candidate. The isolated run then exposed actual COPY/MOVE incompatibilities (including 501 and 412); its full raw output is retained separately and does not alter baseline suite totals.
